property_summary: After any fallback invocation that does not revert, the contract's pastBlockTime must be greater than or equal to the block.timestamp of the previous fallback call's block; the mutant never updates pastBlockTime, so a second call with a later timestamp will succeed when it should fail due to the require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) check being satisfied with the stale old timestamp.
change_summary: Delete the pastBlockTime update so pastBlockTime stays unchanged, altering future fallback eligibility.
